name: Correios
description: Connect your Correios contract so the agent can track a shipment by its tracking code: current status, latest event, history, delivery date, and whether the parcel has stopped moving.

correios_track_shipment.label: Track Shipment
correios_track_shipment.description: Track a Correios shipment by its tracking code: current status, latest event, history and delivery date. Only parcels posted under your own Correios contract.

username.label: Correios user
username.description: The Meu Correios user of your company account (idCorreios, usually the CNPJ) that holds the contract.

accessCode.label: API access code
accessCode.description: The "código de acesso" generated in CWS (cws.correios.com.br → Gestão de acesso a APIs). It is not your Meu Correios password.

postingCard.label: Cartão de postagem
postingCard.description: The number of the cartão de postagem you post your parcels with. Enter this, the contract number, or both.

contractNumber.label: Contract number
contractNumber.description: Your Correios contract number. Needed only when you do not enter a cartão de postagem.

staleTrackingDomesticDays.label: Stale tracking (days)
staleTrackingDomesticDays.description: Treat a shipment as stuck when its tracking has not moved for more than this many days.
